def mvcc.api.KV.DeleteRange.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (key endk : GoSlice) (k e : GoString) (L : List w64)
    (I : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem w64) (q : Qp) (B : mvcc.api.BkRef) (P Pre Q' Post : IProp GF)
    (f : GoFunc) (Q : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
    have ds := fun σ => List.map mvcc.Change.del (mvcc.delKeys σ.log [] (decide (endk = slice.nil)) k e);
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ∗
              threadTok ∗
                ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗
                  ownSlice endk e DFrac.discard ∗
                    lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L I ∗
                      mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                        mvcc.api.hookIs B f ∗
                          Pre ∗
                            mvcc.api.hookRun P f Pre Q' ∗
                              (Q' ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post) ∗
                                AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ ∗ ⌜mvcc.pendItems σ.log [] = I⌝ }> @
                                    ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                                    ⌜σ.pending = none⌝ ∗
                                      mvcc.api.mvccState γ (σ.notify (ds σ)) ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh (σ.log ++ [ds σ])),
                                    COMM
                                    AU <{ ∃∃ σ', mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ' }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                                        ⌜σ' = σ.notify (ds σ)⌝ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ'.commitPending, COMM Q σ }> }> -∗
          (▷
              ∀ n rev,
                (threadTok ∗
                    mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                      Post ∗
                        ∃ σ,
                          Q σ ∗
                            lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L (mvcc.pendItems σ.log (ds σ)) ∗
                              ⌜n = W64 ↑(ds σ).length ∧ rev = W64 ↑(mvcc.writeRev σ.log (ds σ))⌝) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal n, intoVal rev)) -∗
            WP
              (((intoVal (methods ty go!"DeleteRange" v))
                  (intoVal key))
                (intoVal endk))
              {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.excl.law : Prop :=
  (∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (σ σ' : mvcc.api.MvccState), mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ' ⊢ False) ∧
    (∀ (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (S S' : mvcc.api.StreamState), mvcc.api.wsState ι S ∗ mvcc.api.wsState ι S' ⊢ False) ∧
      (∀ (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (rs rs' : List mvcc.api.WResp), mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs ∗ mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs' ⊢ False) ∧
        ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName), mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ⊢ False

def mvcc.api.mvccBackend_agree.law : Prop :=

    mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B Pk ∗ mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q' B' Pk' ⊢ ⌜B = B'⌝

def mvcc.api.wrespIs (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse) (r : mvcc.api.WResp)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜v.WatchID' = r.id ∧ v.Revision' = r.rev ∧ v.CompactRevision' = r.compactRev⌝ ∗
      ∃ ps,
        ownSlice v.Events' ps DFrac.discard ∗
          ⌜ps.length = r.evs.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ ps.zip r.evs, mvcc.evIs x.fst x.snd)

def mvcc.api.shapes.law : Prop :=
  (∀ (kv : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName),
      mvcc.api.isMvcc kv γ ⊢ ⌜∃ ty v, kv = interface.mkOk ty v ∧ mvcc.api.isKV ty v⌝) ∧
    (∀ (ws : Loc),
        mvcc.api.isWatchableKV go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal ws)) ∧
      (∀ (t : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (k : mvcc.api.MTxn),
          mvcc.api.mvccTxn t γ trace k ⊢ ⌜∃ ty v, t = interface.mkOk ty v ∧ mvcc.api.isTxn ty v⌝) ∧
        ∀ (w : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (ι : mvcc.api.WsName),
          mvcc.api.isMvccWatchStream w γ ι ⊢ ⌜∃ ty v, w = interface.mkOk ty v ∧ mvcc.api.isWatchStream ty v⌝

def mvcc.api.Txn.End.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (k : mvcc.api.MTxn) (q : Qp) (B : mvcc.api.BkRef) (P Q : IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        (isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace k ∗
              match k with
              | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => True
              | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ₀ pend =>
                mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                  P ∗
                    AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                        ⌜σ = σ₀⌝ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccState γ (σ.notify pend) ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh (σ.log ++ [pend])), COMM
                        AU <{ ∃∃ σ', mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ' }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                            ⌜σ' = σ₀.notify pend⌝ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ'.commitPending, COMM Q }> }>) -∗
          ▷
              ((threadTok ∗
                  match k with
                  | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => True
                  | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend => mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗ Q) -∗
                Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
            WP ((intoVal (methods ty go!"End" v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.KV.Restore.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (B B' : mvcc.api.BkRef) (Pk Pk' : IProp GF) (σ' : mvcc.api.MvccState) (u : Bool)
    (L : List w64) (dq : DFrac) (f : GoFunc) (Pre Q' Post X Y : IProp GF) (Q : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ∗
              threadTok ∗
                mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                  mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ 1 B Pk ∗
                    mvcc.api.mvccBackendFor B' Pk' σ'.log σ'.crev u ∗
                      ⌜mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ' ∧ σ'.pending = none⌝ ∗
                        backend.plHookAt B'.γB dq f ∗
                          Pre ∗
                            mvcc.api.hookRun Pk' f Pre Q' ∗
                              (Q' ={⊤}=∗ Pk' ∗ Post) ∗
                                X ∗
                                  backend.commitReq B'.γB B'.P Pk' B'.b X Y ∗
                                    lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L ∅ ∗
                                      ⌜∀ (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem) (lid : w64),
                                            mvcc.pendItems σ'.log [] !! it = some lid →
                                              lid ∈ L ∧ ↑(List.length it.Key') < 2 ^ 63 - 1⌝ ∗
                                        AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ ∗ ⌜σ.log <+: σ'.log ∧ σ.crev ≤ σ'.crev⌝ }> @
                                            ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ' ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh σ'.log), COMM
                                            Q σ }> -∗
          ▷
              ((threadTok ∗
                  mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                    mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ 1 B' Pk' ∗
                      ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdStockN (), backend.bOpen B.γB backend.rdOpen) ∗
                        backend.plHookAt B'.γB dq f ∗
                          (if u = true then Post ∗ Y else Pre ∗ X) ∗
                            lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L (mvcc.pendItems σ'.log []) ∗ ∃ σ, Q σ) -∗
                Φ (intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal (methods ty go!"Restore" v))
                (intoVal
                  (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType (intoVal B'.b))))
              {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.KV.Range.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (todo : Bool) (key endk : GoSlice)
    (kk e : GoString) (ro : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RangeOptions) (Q : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ∗
              threadTok ∗
                mvcc.rangeCtx todo ctx cd ∗
                  ownSlice key kk DFrac.discard ∗
                    ownSlice endk e DFrac.discard ∗
                      AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ, COMM
                          Q σ }> -∗
          (▷
              ∀ r err,
                (threadTok ∗
                    ⌜todo = true → r ≠ null⌝ ∗
                      ∃ σ,
                        Q σ ∗
                          mvcc.rangeOutcomeC r err σ.log (W64 ↑σ.rev) σ.crev (decide (endk = slice.nil)) kk e ro ∗
                            ⌜∀ (r' : Nat), σ.crev ≤ ↑r' → r' ≤ σ.rev → mvcc.api.stateOk (mvcc.stateAt σ.log r')⌝) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal r, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              (((((intoVal (methods ty go!"Range" v)) (intoVal (GoInterface.ok ctx)))
                    (intoVal key))
                  (intoVal endk))
                (intoVal ro))
              {{ Φ }}

                        lease.lessorRdOf γl ∗ mvcc.isLessor le γl ∗ lease.rdOwn γl rd0 -∗

                        Φ (intoVal s)) -∗

                    Q S }> -∗

                    ∃ S,

                            typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrWatcherNotExist) err
                              DFrac.discard)) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
            WP ((intoVal (methods ty go!"Cancel" v)) (intoVal id)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.mvccImage_fresh.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : backend.Data),

      backend.dget D go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName mvcc.schedKeyBytes = none →
        backend.dget D go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName mvcc.finKeyBytes = none →
          ⊢ |==> mvcc.api.mvccImage D mvcc.api.mvccStart.log mvcc.api.mvccStart.crev false

def mvcc.api.persistent.law : Prop :=
  (∀ (kv : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName), Persistent (mvcc.api.isMvcc kv γ)) ∧
    (∀ (ws : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (ι : mvcc.api.WsName), Persistent (mvcc.api.isMvccWatchStream ws γ ι)) ∧
      (∀ (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (n : Nat), Persistent (mvcc.api.wsSentLb ι n)) ∧
        (∀ (D : backend.Data) (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (u : Bool), Persistent (mvcc.api.mvccImage D L c u)) ∧
          (∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState), Timeless (mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ)) ∧
            (∀ (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState), Timeless (mvcc.api.wsState ι S)) ∧
              (∀ (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp), Timeless (mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs)) ∧
                ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (B : mvcc.api.BkRef) (Pk : IProp GF),
                  Fractional fun q => mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B Pk

def mvcc.api.hookRun (P : IProp GF) (f : GoFunc) (Pre Q : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  if f = func.nil then iprop(P ∗ Pre ={⊤}=∗ Q)
  else iprop(□ □ ∀ Φ, P ∗ Pre -∗ ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP ((intoVal f) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.api.KV.Compact.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (te : Bool) (rev : w64) (q : Qp) (B : mvcc.api.BkRef) (P : IProp GF)
    (f : GoFunc) (Pre Q' Post X Y : IProp GF) (Q : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ∗
              mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                threadTok ∗
                  ⌜trace ≠ null⌝ ∗
                    ⌜1 ≤ sint.Z rev⌝ ∗
                      traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                        mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                          mvcc.api.hookIs B f ∗
                            X ∗
                              backend.commitReq B.γB B.P P B.b X Y ∗
                                Pre ∗
                                  mvcc.api.hookRun P f Pre Q' ∗
                                    (Q' ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post) ∗
                                      AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                                          mvcc.api.mvccState γ
                                            (if σ.crev < sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z rev ≤ ↑σ.rev then σ.compactTo (sint.Z rev)
                                            else σ),
                                          COMM Q σ }> -∗
          (▷
              ∀ ch err,
                (mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                    threadTok ∗
                      traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                        mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                          ∃ σ,
                            Q σ ∗
                              (⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ σ.crev < sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z rev ≤ ↑σ.rev⌝ ∗
                                  Post ∗ Y ∗ mvcc.api.compactChanOk ch ∨
                                ⌜sint.Z rev ≤ σ.crev⌝ ∗
                                    typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrCompacted) err
                                        DFrac.discard ∗
                                      Pre ∗ X ∗ mvcc.api.compactChanOk ch ∨
                                  ⌜↑σ.rev < sint.Z rev ∧ ch = chan.nil⌝ ∗
                                    typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrFutureRev) err
                                        DFrac.discard ∗
                                      Pre ∗ X)) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal ch, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP (((intoVal (methods ty go!"Compact" v)) (intoVal trace)) (intoVal rev))
              {{ Φ }}

      ∀ ty v kh,
        ⌜h = interface.mkOk ty v⌝ -∗
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              True -∗
                ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP ((intoVal (methods ty go!"Store" v)) (intoVal kh)) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.api.WatchStream.RequestProgress.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (id : w64),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvccWatchStream (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ι ∗ threadTok -∗
          ▷ (threadTok -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal
                  (methods ty
                    go!"RequestProgress"
                    v))
                (intoVal id))
              {{ Φ }}

def (sealed) mvcc.api.wsChanNames (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) : ChanNames

def mvcc.api.store.Range.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Loc), mvcc.api.KV.Range.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)

def mvcc.api.reach_logWf.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState), mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ → mvcc.LogWf' σ.log ∧ mvcc.LogWf' σ.notifiedLog

def mvcc.api.Txn.DeleteRange.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (key endk : GoSlice)
    (k e : GoString) (L : List w64),
    have ds := List.map mvcc.Change.del (mvcc.delKeys σ.log pend (decide (endk = slice.nil)) k e);
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace (mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend) ∗
              ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗
                ownSlice endk e DFrac.discard ∗ lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L (mvcc.pendItems σ.log pend) -∗
          (▷
              ∀ n rev,
                mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace (mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ (pend ++ ds)) ∗
                    lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L (mvcc.pendItems σ.log (pend ++ ds)) ∗
                      ⌜n = W64 ↑ds.length ∧ rev = W64 ↑(mvcc.writeRev σ.log (pend ++ ds))⌝ -∗
                  Φ (intoVal n, intoVal rev)) -∗
            WP
              (((intoVal (methods ty go!"DeleteRange" v))
                  (intoVal key))
                (intoVal endk))
              {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.KV.HashStorage.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗ mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ -∗
          (▷ ∀ h, mvcc.api.hashStoreOk h -∗ Φ (intoVal h)) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal (methods ty go!"HashStorage" v))
                (intoVal ()))
              {{ Φ }}

theorem mvcc.api.reach_logWf.law_holds : mvcc.api.reach_logWf.law

def mvcc.api.watchableStore.FirstRev.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Loc),
    mvcc.api.KV.FirstRev.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)

def mvcc.api.watchableStore.Close.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Loc), mvcc.api.KV.Close.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)

def mvcc.api.isKV (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  mvcc.api.KV.Read.contract ty v ∧
    mvcc.api.KV.Write.contract ty v ∧
      mvcc.api.KV.Rev.contract ty v ∧
        mvcc.api.KV.FirstRev.contract ty v ∧
          mvcc.api.KV.Range.contract ty v ∧
            mvcc.api.KV.Put.contract ty v ∧
              mvcc.api.KV.DeleteRange.contract ty v ∧
                mvcc.api.KV.Compact.contract ty v ∧
                  mvcc.api.KV.Commit.contract ty v ∧
                    mvcc.api.KV.Restore.contract ty v ∧
                      mvcc.api.KV.HashStorage.contract ty v ∧ mvcc.api.KV.Close.contract ty v

def (sealed) mvcc.api.mvccW (gx : GName) : IProp GF

def (sealed) mvcc.api.mvccState (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : IProp GF

def mvcc.api.mvccW_alloc.law : Prop :=
  ⊢ |==> ∃ gx, mvcc.api.mvccWReg gx ∗ mvcc.api.mvccW gx

def mvcc.api.Txn.Put.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (te : Bool) (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (pend : List mvcc.Change)
    (key value : GoSlice) (k vv : GoString) (leaseID : w64) (L : List w64),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace (mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend) ∗
              traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗
                  ownSlice value vv DFrac.discard ∗
                    ⌜↑(List.length k) < 2 ^ 63 - 1⌝ ∗
                      lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L (mvcc.pendItems σ.log pend) ∗
                        ⌜leaseID = W64 0 ∨ leaseID ∈ L⌝ -∗
          ▷
              (mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace
                    (mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ (pend ++ [mvcc.Change.put k vv leaseID])) ∗
                  traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                    lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L
                      (mvcc.pendItems σ.log (pend ++ [mvcc.Change.put k vv leaseID])) -∗
                Φ (intoVal (W64 ↑(List.length σ.log)))) -∗
            WP ((((intoVal (methods ty go!"Put" v)) (intoVal key)) (intoVal value)) (intoVal leaseID)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.wsChan_recv.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ws : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (ι : mvcc.api.WsName),
    mvcc.api.isMvccWatchStream ws γ ι ⊢
      isChan (mvcc.api.wsChanOf ι) (mvcc.api.wsChanNames ι) go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse ∗
        (□
            ∀ rs Φ,
              mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs -∗
                (∀ v ok,
                    (if ok = true then ∃ r, mvcc.api.wsRecv ι (rs ++ [r]) ∗ mvcc.api.wrespIs v r
                      else mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs) -∗
                      Φ v ok) -∗
                  recvAu (mvcc.api.wsChanNames ι) go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse Φ) ∗
          □
            ∀ rs n Φ Ψ,
              mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs -∗
                mvcc.api.wsSentLb ι n -∗
                  (∀ v ok,
                        (if ok = true then ∃ r, mvcc.api.wsRecv ι (rs ++ [r]) ∗ mvcc.api.wrespIs v r
                          else mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs) -∗
                          Φ v ok) ∧
                      (mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs -∗ ⌜n ≤ rs.length⌝ -∗ Ψ) -∗
                    nonblockingRecvAuAlt (mvcc.api.wsChanNames ι) go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse Φ Ψ

def mvcc.api.watchableStore.Rev.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Loc), mvcc.api.KV.Rev.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)

    mvcc.api.WsName) : IProp GF

def (sealed) mvcc.api.wsChanOf (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) : GoChan

def mvcc.api.Txn.FirstRev.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (k : mvcc.api.MTxn),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗ mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace k -∗
          ▷
              (mvcc.api.mvccTxn (interface.mkOk ty v) γ trace k -∗
                Φ
                  (intoVal
                    (match k with
                    | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => W64 σ.crev
                    | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend => W64 0))) -∗
            WP ((intoVal (methods ty go!"FirstRev" v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.isTxn (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  mvcc.api.Txn.Rev.contract ty v ∧
    mvcc.api.Txn.FirstRev.contract ty v ∧
      mvcc.api.Txn.Range.contract ty v ∧
        mvcc.api.Txn.Put.contract ty v ∧
          mvcc.api.Txn.DeleteRange.contract ty v ∧ mvcc.api.Txn.Changes.contract ty v ∧ mvcc.api.Txn.End.contract ty v

def mvcc.api.isWatchStream (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  mvcc.api.WatchStream.Watch.contract ty v ∧
    mvcc.api.WatchStream.Chan.contract ty v ∧
      mvcc.api.WatchStream.RequestProgress.contract ty v ∧
        mvcc.api.WatchStream.RequestProgressAll.contract ty v ∧
          mvcc.api.WatchStream.Cancel.contract ty v ∧
            mvcc.api.WatchStream.Close.contract ty v ∧ mvcc.api.WatchStream.Rev.contract ty v

def mvcc.api.txnReadWrite.End.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : Loc), mvcc.api.Txn.End.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.txnReadWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal t)

def mvcc.api.store.Commit.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Loc), mvcc.api.KV.Commit.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)

def mvcc.api.New.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (lg : Loc) (le : GoInterface) (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.StoreConfig) (B : mvcc.api.BkRef)
    (Pk : IProp GF) (γl : GName) (rd0 : GoFunc),
    mvcc.batchLimitOk cfg.CompactionBatchLimit' →
      receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 48 →
        threadBound GF ≤ backend.rdStockN →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
                  isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗
                    isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗
                      mvcc.api.mvccBackendFor B Pk mvcc.api.mvccStart.log mvcc.api.mvccStart.crev false ∗
                        lease.lessorRdOf γl ∗ mvcc.isLessor le γl ∗ lease.rdOwn γl rd0 -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ ws,
                      (∃ γ,
                          ⌜mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ = γl⌝ ∗
                            mvcc.api.isMvcc
                                (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType
                                  (intoVal ws))
                                γ ∗
                              mvcc.api.mvccState γ mvcc.api.mvccStart ∗
                                mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                                  mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ 1 B Pk ∗ ∃ rd, lease.rdOwn γl rd ∗ mvcc.api.mvccDeleter rd γ) -∗
                        Φ
                          (intoVal
                            (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType
                              (intoVal ws)))) -∗
                  WP
                    (((((intoVal (functions go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.New [])) (intoVal lg))
                          (intoVal
                            (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType
                              (intoVal B.b))))
                        (intoVal le))
                      (intoVal cfg))
                    {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.wsRecv_ok.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ws : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState)
    (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState),
    mvcc.api.isMvccWatchStream ws γ ι ∗ mvcc.api.wsRecv ι rs ∗ mvcc.api.wsState ι S ∗ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ ⊢
      ⌜mvcc.api.wsRecvOk σ S rs⌝

def mvcc.api.mvccBackendFor_open.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (γB : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk K : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data)
    (gx : GName) (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (u : Bool),
    ⊢
      ((□ ∀ γ b', mvcc.keySized γ P b') ∗
          mvcc.api.mvccImage D L c u ∗
            backend.newPostKP γB P (fun x => mvcc.api.mvccW gx) Pk K b D ∗
              mvcc.api.mvccWReg gx ∗
                backend.wbTok γB ∗
                  backend.wbTok γB ∗
                    □ (⧗1 ={⊤}=∗ backend.wbTok γB) ∗
                      [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdStockN (), backend.bOpen γB backend.rdOpen) ={⊤}=∗
        mvcc.api.mvccBackendFor { γB := γB, P := P, b := b } (Pk γB) L c u ∗ mvcc.api.backendRest γB P K b D

def mvcc.api.KV.Put.contract (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (key value : GoSlice) (k vv : GoString) (leaseID : w64) (L : List w64)
    (I : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem w64) (q : Qp) (B : mvcc.api.BkRef) (P Pre Q' Post : IProp GF)
    (f : GoFunc) (Q : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ∗
              threadTok ∗
                ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗
                  ownSlice value vv DFrac.discard ∗
                    ⌜↑(List.length k) < 2 ^ 63 - 1⌝ ∗
                      lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L I ∗
                        ⌜leaseID = W64 0 ∨ leaseID ∈ L⌝ ∗
                          mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                            mvcc.api.hookIs B f ∗
                              Pre ∗
                                mvcc.api.hookRun P f Pre Q' ∗
                                  (Q' ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post) ∗
                                    AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ ∗ ⌜mvcc.pendItems σ.log [] = I⌝ }> @
                                        ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                                        ⌜σ.pending = none⌝ ∗
                                          mvcc.api.mvccState γ (σ.notify [mvcc.Change.put k vv leaseID]) ∗
                                            ⧖(mvcc.logCh (σ.log ++ [[mvcc.Change.put k vv leaseID]])),
                                        COMM
                                        AU <{ ∃∃ σ', mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ' }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                                            ⌜σ' = σ.notify [mvcc.Change.put k vv leaseID]⌝ ∗
                                              mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ'.commitPending,
                                            COMM Q σ }> }> -∗
          (▷
              ∀ rev,
                (threadTok ∗
                    mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                      Post ∗
                        ∃ σ,
                          Q σ ∗
                            lease.leaseOwn (mvcc.api.mvccLeases γ) L
                                (mvcc.pendItems σ.log [mvcc.Change.put k vv leaseID]) ∗
                              ⌜rev = W64 ↑(List.length σ.log)⌝) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal rev)) -∗
            WP ((((intoVal (methods ty go!"Put" v)) (intoVal key)) (intoVal value)) (intoVal leaseID)) {{ Φ }}

def (sealed) mvcc.api.wsRecv (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) : IProp GF

def mvcc.api.mvccDeleter (rd : GoFunc) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜rd ≠ func.nil⌝ ∗
      □
        ∀ q B P Pre Q f R,
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              threadTok ∗
                  mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                    mvcc.api.hookIs B f ∗
                      Pre ∗
                        mvcc.api.hookRun P f Pre Q ∗
                          AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                              ⌜σ.pending = none⌝ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ, COMM R σ }> -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ t,
                      mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                          (∃ trace σ, mvcc.api.mvccTxn t γ trace (mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ []) ∗ R σ) ∗ Q -∗
                        Φ (intoVal t)) -∗
                  WP ((intoVal rd) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

  ∀ (t : Loc), mvcc.api.Txn.Put.contract go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.metricsTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal t)

def (sealed) mvcc.api.wsSentLb (ι : mvcc.api.WsName) (n : Nat) : IProp GF

def (sealed) mvcc.api.mvccWReg (gx : GName) : IProp GF
